column7: 2026-11-04: Added humanize.percent(fraction, precision=1) in number.py (exported, tested). Context: humanize is used only on customer billing/usage pages. Non-numeric input returns str(value) and nan/inf use _format_not_finite, matching scientific(); no locale decimal separator handling yet.

2026-11-04: percent() rounds half UP (decimal arithmetic on repr(float), ROUND_HALF_UP), not Python's half-even float formatting. Reason: output must match billing's invoice generator exactly (e.g. 0.125 at precision 0 -> '13%'). Negatives round away from zero; unconfirmed with billing.

2026-11-04: Added humanize.gigabytes(num_bytes, precision=1) in filesize.py (exported, tested): always GB (10**9), no unit scaling. Uses plain float formatting (round-half-even), NOT percent()'s half-up; billing's half-up requirement was only stated for percent. Revisit if invoice usage figures must match for GB too. Non-numeric -> str(value); nan/inf via number._format_not_finite.
